capabilities: Schedule flashcard reviews with the FSRS-6 algorithm
Record review ratings in each note's frontmatter reviews field
Display review queues with customizable fsrs-table blocks
Configure target retention and interval parameters and view statistics
disambiguation: Not the FSRS algorithm library itself; it is an Obsidian plugin that applies the algorithm to schedule and review note-based flashcards.
extras: Weight retraining on the user's own review statistics is not yet supported. iOS and macOS are listed as untested; a step-by-step usage guide with screenshots is linked separately.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in spaced repetition scheduling, so learners must review notes with a separate flashcard application.

relations.evidence: The plugin uses rs-fsrs — the official Rust FSRS implementation by the algorithm authors

summary: Spaced repetition scheduler that turns notes into flashcards using the FSRS-6 algorithm, storing review history in frontmatter and showing queues in tables.
